## Context
Child 3 of 3 under epic acute-agitable-xiphosuran (003c-2dd2-203a-4725), per the operator
decomposition decision of 2026-08-19. Sequenced LAST — not because of defect count, but because it
COLLIDES with the reconciler port-boundary work already scoped by cc77-8120-bcc6-47e8. Landing this
first would force annotations onto seams that work is actively reshaping, producing merge churn and
annotations that describe a boundary about to change.

## Scope
Promote `rebar._engine.*` into tier 1 (`disallow_untyped_defs`) in pyproject.toml and pin it in
`_RATCHET_BASELINE`. Residue measured on main @ ea6ee67e6a: 134 untyped defs, ~224 explicit Any —
the largest explicit-Any concentration of the three packages.

## Sequencing constraint — RESOLVED 2026-08-19
The epic's original rationale for sequencing this child last was a collision with the reconciler
port-boundary work on cc77-8120-bcc6-47e8. **That ticket is now CLOSED** (verified 2026-08-19), as
is its parent e369-a449-4773-48fb ("Jira Server / Data Center support via a Jira-family seam"), so
the collision no longer blocks this work and no blocking link was recorded.

What survives from that rationale: the seams cc77-8120 reshaped have MOVED, so the residue figures
above (measured on main @ ea6ee67e6a) are stale. **Re-measure at claim time** before planning the
work; do not treat the 134/~224 counts as current.

## Constraints (inherited from the epic)
- No `cast()`, no `: Any` / `-> Any` to satisfy the ratchet.
- Tier 2 is a separate later step.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `mypy src/rebar/_engine --disallow-untyped-defs` is clean with NO new `: Any` / `-> Any`.
- [ ] `rebar._engine.*` is in the tier-1 override and pinned in `_RATCHET_BASELINE`.
- [ ] No file exceeds the 800 LOC cap; complexity ratchet shows no new/increased entries.
- [ ] Behaviour unchanged: existing engine/reconciler tests pass unmodified.
